test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 31 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.**

Nisha participates in almost every activity and in all functions held in the school as she __has many skills.__
solution:
The correct answer is: **Versatile.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Versatile** means able to adapt or be adapted to many different functions or activities.

 *** • Example- ******He is a man of versatile abilities.***

 
• So, it is clear that the **'Versatile' **can be used as a one-word substitute for **'who has many skills'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vulnerable** means exposed to the possibility of being attacked or harmed, either physically or emotionally.
 
• **Innovative** means introducing new ideas; original and creative in thinking.
 
• **Fragile** means easily broken or damaged.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3.**
